entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. Your call is very important to us. Please hold while we connect you with the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, this is Sarah, how can I help you today?
Hi Sarah, I recently received my new VeloFit exercise bike and I think something is wrong with it.
I'm sorry to hear that. Can you tell me more about the issue you're experiencing?

Well, when I was putting it together, I noticed the frame. It has a pretty significant cracked frame near where the seat post inserts. It's unusable. Also, the front wheel seems like it has a wobbly wheel; it just doesn't spin correctly.

Oh no, that sounds terrible! I sincerely apologize for the condition of your new VeloFit bike. It sounds like you received shipping damage, which is unacceptable. We want to make things right immediately.
Okay, well what can be done?
I can certainly help with that. To resolve this quickly, I'm happy to offer you a full refund for the bike. We'll also provide a free label for you to return it to us at no cost.

Absolutely! I've already processed the refund, and you should see it reflected in your account within 3-5 business days. I've also emailed you a free label to print out. Simply attach it to the original packaging and schedule a pickup with the carrier, or drop it off at your convenience.
Wow, that was fast. Thank you so much!
You're very welcome! We value your business and are truly sorry for the inconvenience this has caused. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, I think that's everything. Thank you again for your help!
Of course! Have a wonderful day and thank you for choosing VeloFit!
